claims.claim: charophytes 0.1–21 g DW m⁻² in low-P lakes (abstract)
claims.note: Full text not obtained. But the abstract the paper relies on gives 0.1–21 g dry weight per m² as PERIPHYTON biomass ('Periphyton biomass in the tested lakes reached 0.1–21 g dry weight/m²', grown on artificial substrates for four weeks in July and August), not charophyte biomass. Charophyte abundance was mapped in five cover classes. The 11 lakes were oligo-mesotrophic hardwater lakes with TP 9–22 µg/L. The table's value is almost certainly misattributed and should be removed or relabelled as periphyton.

notes: Abstract (Crossref): charophyte abundance was predicted by periphyton biomass and benthivorous bream biomass, not herbivorous rudd; bream biomass rose linearly with lake TP; periphyton was mainly controlled bottom-up by P, top-down in only three lakes. These German hardwater lakes are a weak analog for Hot Brook's soft, coloured water.
